sents.en: Mars is a planet.
Planets orbit stars.
Planets in our solar system orbit the sun.
sents.ko: 우리 태양계의 행성들은 태양 주위를 돌아요.

sents.en: Mars is the fourth planet from the sun.
It is about 142 million miles (229 million km) from the sun.
sents.ko: 태양에서 약 1억 4,200만 마일(2억 2,900만 km) 떨어져 있어요.

sents.en: Mars fully orbits the sun every 687 days.
sents.ko: 화성은 687일마다 태양을 완전히 한 바퀴 돌아요.

sents.en: One year on Mars is 1.8 years on Earth.
Mars spins while in orbit.
sents.ko: 화성은 궤도를 도는 동안 스스로 회전해요.

sents.en: One full spin takes a little longer than 24 hours.
sents.ko: 한 바퀴 회전하는 데 24시간보다 조금 더 걸려요.

sents.en: One day on Mars lasts nearly as long as one day on Earth.
sents.ko: 화성의 하루는 지구의 하루와 거의 같아요.

sents.en: The air is very thin on Mars.
It is made mostly of a gas called carbon dioxide.
Dust that is rich in iron covers Mars.
sents.ko: 철이 많이 든 먼지가 화성을 덮고 있어요.

sents.en: That is why Mars is red.
Mars is very dry.
It can be windy.
The wind causes large dust storms.
sents.ko: 그 바람이 커다란 모래 폭풍을 일으켜요.

sents.en: Mars is tilted like Earth.
Mars has seasons just like Earth.
But, its seasons last longer.
Mars can be seen from Earth in the night sky.
You just have to know where to look!
What did you think?
Did you like Mars?
Would you go with me if we could?
sents.ko: 갈 수 있다면 저와 함께 갈래요?

sents.en: I hope that we can all go to Mars together someday.
sents.ko: 언젠가 우리 모두 함께 화성에 갈 수 있으면 좋겠어요.

sents.en: Okay. That's all for now. See you next time!
sents.ko: 좋아요. 오늘은 여기까지예요. 다음에 또 만나요!
